topography.project_purpose: DeltaPrime is a leveraged farming protocol that enables users to borrow assets against their deposits to amplify yield farming positions. It operates across multiple chains, providing pools for various tokens and integrating with external DeFi protocols for yield generation and liquidation.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Lending and Borrowing Pools provide the capital for leveraged positions, while the Smart Loan Management family uses diamond proxies to create and manage individual user loans that interact with these pools. Shared infrastructure includes governance contracts (TokenManager, AssetsExposureController) and intermediary contracts that connect the loan management system to external DEXs and yield protocols.
